entries.content: BOS GUI (crates/gui, crate bsh) code review 2026-10-11 filed 9 issues (#4-#12) on open1s/bos: pty.rs AnsiFilter UTF-8-split mojibake (#4) and pending-wipe OSC leak (#5) — both reproduced with byte-exact re-implementation; workspace switch staleness in run/file/mentions/PTY (#6, backend reads settings.bash_workspace global not effective()); allow_tool scope=session leaks to all brokers (#7); stream-finished task event dropped (missing cancelled field, seq collision) (#8); doc-tab close span not keyboard accessible (#9); open_url macOS-only (#10); schedule_tick saves every 30s (#11); Inner.brokers unbounded growth (#12). Candidates verified and REJECTED: markdown link attribute injection (escapeMd escapes quotes/angles first), send_message missing streaming guard (supersession by design via runner.spawn stop), delete_session forwarder race (handled by gen guard).
